scope.time_basis: return time for returns; rental time for rentals; original local clock timestamps
scope.calendar: Public holiday leave dates and ordinary weekends use weekend window; official makeup workday uses weekday windows.

assumptions.patch_partition: Identical accessible directed-arc ID set + maximal four-neighbour connected component outside GP.
assumptions.service_access: At most 50m via the frozen strict same-side graph; each cell may use a different stopping point on the arc.
assumptions.inventory: One inventory per GP or patch. Arc unions must deduplicate patch IDs; initial stock is not supplied.
assumptions.directions: Frozen audited L2 graph and generic OSM one-way rules. No claim of complete real-world turn or vehicle restrictions.
assumptions.coordinates: Cell geometry and road snapshots remain in frozen inputs. Internal link geometry retains original road node IDs.
assumptions.priority: Ascending directed-arc reach degree, then mean minimum access distance rounded to 3 decimals, then patch ID; not driving order.
